info.name: Ramz Website API
info.description:
Every backend endpoint called by the public Next.js site in `website/` (generated by static analysis of `src/lib/api.js`, hooks, components, `app/api/proxy/*` and `app/sitemap.js`).

All requests are public: no auth headers, tokens or cookies are needed. Set `baseUrl` to the backend (`https://www.ramzelsharq.com/dashboard/api`) or to the website proxy (`https://www.ramzelsharq.com/api/proxy`). See `postman/README.md`.

Example responses are **representative** (built from the fields the frontend reads), not captured from the live API.

request.description:
Used by `getProducts` via `useProducts` and SSR `loadProducts`.

Callers: `products/ProductsSection`, `agent-details/AgentsProducts`, `agent-details/AvailableCategories`, `article-details/SimilarProducts`, `app/sitemap.js`.

Search/filter is client-side only (fuse.js on `name`, `categoryName`, `agentName`; `?category=` / `?agent=` URL params). Server-side fetch is cached for 300 s (`next.revalidate`).

Response uses `data.items`, `data.totalCount`, `data.totalPages`, `data.pageNumber`.

request.description:
Fired once per article page load from `app/[locale]/articles/[articleId]/ArticleDetailsClient.jsx`:

```js
fetch(`/api/proxy/articles/${id}/view`, { method: "POST", credentials: "include" })
```

**No request body and no query params.** The browser call goes to the Next.js route `app/api/proxy/articles/[id]/view/route.js`, which forwards a bodiless POST with `Content-Type: application/json` to `{{baseUrl}}/articles/{id}/view`. Cookies sent with `credentials: "include"` are **not** forwarded to the backend.

Response shape isn't read by the frontend; the proxy returns the backend JSON or `{}`.
